title: Uniqueness of normalized ordinary finite pullback
statement: theorem ordinaryFinitePull_unique (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (e e' : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n) ≅ change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))) (he : ∀ M : Mod (constant J A), pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫ insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫ (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e.hom.app M) = L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫ pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))) ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)) (he' : ∀ M : Mod (constant J A), pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫ insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫ (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e'.hom.app M) = L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫ pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))) ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)) : e = e'

proof.text: For each module M, apply injectivity of the Hom equivalence for extension along the finite quotient, then that for extension along constantMap. Apply faithfulness of the underlying-sheaf functor and precompose with the inverse-image module-underlying isomorphism. The scalar-extension adjunction unit has exactly the insertion section formula, by insertion_existsUnique. Consequently the twice-adjoint maps are precisely the two insertion composites in he and he′. Those composites agree because both equal the prescribed right-hand side. Componentwise equality gives equality of natural transformations and then of natural isomorphisms.

theorem ordinaryFinitePull_unique
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (e e' : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n) ≅
        change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))))
    (he : ∀ M : Mod (constant J A),
      pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫
          insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫
          (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e.hom.app M) =
        L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫
          pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))
            ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M))
    (he' : ∀ M : Mod (constant J A),
      pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫
          insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫
          (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e'.hom.app M) =
        L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫
          pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))
            ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)) : e = e'
